_note: max_build_steps_per_slide is counted by lint_motion.py as one entry per
effect NODE (_build_steps walks every cTn with a presetClass), not per
perceived build step. A four-card row that fills left-to-right is one
step to an audience but four to sixteen nodes here, so the number below
is a node ceiling, not a click budget. The click budget is 8 and is
enforced upstream by motion/plan_motion.py (MAX_STEPS), which emits one
step per band and staggers the columns inside it with delay instead of
trigger. Raised from 8 to 128 on 2026-08-29 for that reason; the densest
slide (the 15-SKU portfolio map) carries 120 nodes across 5 steps.
